---
title: "SIR with Parallel"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(deSolve)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)

set.seed(123)

# =========================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# =========================================================
times <- seq(0, 60, by = 1)

tau_true   <- 20
beta1_true <- 0.4
beta2_true <- 0.15
gamma_true <- 0.1
sigma_true <- 0.01

candidate_tau <- seq(5, 50, by = 1)

state_init <- c(S = 0.999, I = 0.001, R = 0)

nsim <- 2 # Need to increase
nboot <- 2 # Need to increase

# =========================================================
# 2. MODEL
# =========================================================
sir_cp <- function(t, state, par) {
  S <- state[1]; I <- state[2]; R <- state[3]
  beta <- if (t <= par["tau"]) par["beta1"] else par["beta2"]
  N <- S + I + R
  
  dS <- -beta * S * I / N
  dI <- beta * S * I / N - par["gamma"] * I
  dR <- par["gamma"] * I
  
  list(c(dS, dI, dR))
}

# =========================================================
# 3. SAFE SOLVER
# =========================================================
safe_solve <- function(par) {
  out <- try(
    ode(
      y = state_init,
      times = times,
      func = sir_cp,
      parms = par,
      method = "ode45",
      rtol = 1e-3,
      atol = 1e-4,
      maxsteps = 5000
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  
  out <- as.data.frame(out)
  if (any(!is.finite(out$I))) return(NULL)
  
  out$I <- pmax(pmin(out$I, 1), 0)
  out
}

# =========================================================
# 4. NLL
# =========================================================
nll <- function(p, tau_fixed, y_obs) {
  par <- c(beta1 = p[1], beta2 = p[2], gamma = p[3], tau = tau_fixed)
  
  sim <- safe_solve(par)
  if (is.null(sim)) return(1e12)
  
  mu <- sim$I
  sigma <- max(p[4], 1e-4)
  
  -sum(dnorm(y_obs, mu, sigma, log = TRUE))
}

# =========================================================
# 5. PARALLEL SETUP
# =========================================================
cores <- parallel::detectCores()
cl <- makeCluster(max(1, cores - 1))
registerDoParallel(cl)

cat("Running on", cores - 1, "cores\n")

# =========================================================
# 6. SIMULATION LOOP
# =========================================================
results <- foreach(s = 1:nsim, .combine = rbind,
                   .packages = c("deSolve")) %dopar% {
                     
                     true_par <- c(beta1 = beta1_true,
                                   beta2 = beta2_true,
                                   gamma = gamma_true,
                                   tau = tau_true)
                     
                     sim_true <- safe_solve(true_par)
                     if (is.null(sim_true)) return(NULL)
                     
                     y_obs <- sim_true$I + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma_true)
                     
                     cp_profile <- rep(NA, length(candidate_tau))
                     fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
                     
                     start <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01)
                     
                     for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
                       
                       fit <- try(
                         optim(start, nll,
                               tau_fixed = candidate_tau[i],
                               y_obs = y_obs,
                               method = "L-BFGS-B",
                               lower = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
                               upper = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
                               control = list(maxit = 50)),
                         silent = TRUE
                       )
                       
                       if (!inherits(fit, "try-error") && is.finite(fit$value)) {
                         cp_profile[i] <- fit$value
                         fits[[i]] <- fit
                       }
                     }
                     
                     valid <- which(is.finite(cp_profile))
                     if (length(valid) == 0) return(NULL)
                     
                     best <- valid[which.min(cp_profile[valid])]
                     best_fit <- fits[[best]]
                     
                     par_hat <- best_fit$par
                     names(par_hat) <- c("beta1","beta2","gamma","sigma")
                     
                     data.frame(
                       sim = s,
                       beta1_hat = par_hat["beta1"],
                       beta2_hat = par_hat["beta2"],
                       gamma_hat = par_hat["gamma"],
                       tau_hat = candidate_tau[best]
                     )
                   }

res <- na.omit(results)

cat("\n================ SIMULATION SUMMARY ================\n")
print(res)

# =========================================================
# 7. BOOTSTRAP
# =========================================================
cat("\n================ BOOTSTRAP START ================\n")

boot_results <- foreach(b = 1:nboot, .combine = rbind,
                        .packages = c("deSolve")) %dopar% {
                          
                          base_par <- c(beta1 = mean(res$beta1_hat),
                                        beta2 = mean(res$beta2_hat),
                                        gamma = mean(res$gamma_hat),
                                        tau = median(res$tau_hat))
                          
                          sim_boot <- safe_solve(base_par)
                          if (is.null(sim_boot)) return(NULL)
                          
                          y_boot <- sim_boot$I + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma_true)
                          
                          cp_profile <- rep(NA, length(candidate_tau))
                          fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
                          
                          start <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01)
                          
                          for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
                            
                            fit <- try(
                              optim(start, nll,
                                    tau_fixed = candidate_tau[i],
                                    y_obs = y_boot,
                                    method = "L-BFGS-B",
                                    lower = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
                                    upper = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
                                    control = list(maxit = 50)),
                              silent = TRUE
                            )
                            
                            if (!inherits(fit, "try-error") && is.finite(fit$value)) {
                              cp_profile[i] <- fit$value
                              fits[[i]] <- fit
                            }
                          }
                          
                          valid <- which(is.finite(cp_profile))
                          if (length(valid) == 0) return(NULL)
                          
                          best <- valid[which.min(cp_profile[valid])]
                          
                          par_hat <- fits[[best]]$par
                          names(par_hat) <- c("beta1","beta2","gamma","sigma")
                          
                          data.frame(
                            boot = b,
                            beta1_hat = par_hat["beta1"],
                            beta2_hat = par_hat["beta2"],
                            gamma_hat = par_hat["gamma"],
                            tau_hat = candidate_tau[best]
                          )
                        }

boot_res <- na.omit(boot_results)

cat("\n================ BOOTSTRAP SUMMARY ================\n")
print(data.frame(
  tau_mean = mean(boot_res$tau_hat),
  tau_sd   = sd(boot_res$tau_hat)
))

stopCluster(cl)

# =========================================================
# 8. ================= PLOTS =================
# =========================================================

# ---- (1) Simulation tau distribution
hist(res$tau_hat,
     main = expression("Simulation: Distribution of " * hat(tau)),
     xlab = expression(hat(tau)))

abline(v = tau_true, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# ---- (2) Bootstrap tau distribution
hist(boot_res$tau_hat,
     main = expression("Bootstrap: Distribution of " * hat(tau)),
     xlab = expression(hat(tau)))

abline(v = tau_true, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# ---- (3) Boxplot comparison
boxplot(res$tau_hat, boot_res$tau_hat,
        names = c("Simulation", "Bootstrap"),
        main = "Tau Comparison",
        ylab = expression(hat(tau)))
abline(h = tau_true, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# ---- (4) Example fitted trajectory (mean simulation)
true_par <- c(beta1 = beta1_true,
              beta2 = beta2_true,
              gamma = gamma_true,
              tau = tau_true)

sim_true <- safe_solve(true_par)

mean_par <- c(beta1 = mean(res$beta1_hat),
              beta2 = mean(res$beta2_hat),
              gamma = mean(res$gamma_hat),
              tau = median(res$tau_hat))

sim_fit <- safe_solve(mean_par)

plot(times, sim_true$I, type = "l", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, max(sim_true$I)),
     main = "SIR Fit Comparison",
     ylab = "I(t)", xlab = "Time")

lines(times, sim_fit$I, lwd = 2, col = "blue")

legend("topright",
       legend = c("True", "Fitted"),
       lty = 1,
       col = c("black", "blue"))
```
